title: Limited new-artifact enforcement pilot
baseline_source: main after delegated GRT2-G2 PASS squash merge PR #811

blocking_scope: newly ADDED governed artifacts violating applicable constitutional rules
new permanent repository roots introduced after the pilot baseline
new workflows introduced after the pilot baseline
new writes into constitutionally forbidden roots
new writes into roots classified DEPRECATED_NO_NEW_WRITES
explicitly_not_activated: blocking findings caused solely by modification of pre-existing artifacts unless an independent pre-existing assurance already blocks them
ownership reassignment or deferred PGN adoption

pilot_evidence_threshold.qualification_injection_rule: May supplement missing ordinary-count slots only; must be real PR-shaped prospective integration trees, use no special waiver, exercise declared scope classes, and be labeled QUALIFICATION_INJECTION.

g3_readiness_monitoring.performance_requirement: within frozen G2 budget or incident/requalification
g3_readiness_monitoring.override_requirement: exact and operator-issued only; no broad waiver
g3_readiness_monitoring.historical_dry_run: Before G3 presentation, replay full G3 semantics in shadow over every G2.5 candidate and the last 10 reconstructible real ordinary integration candidates; if fewer than 10 are reconstructible, use all and record HISTORICAL_INTEGRATION_REPLAY_GAP.

warnings: GRT2-G2.5 is operator-reserved and this packet does not activate it.
The ratified plan's GitHub assurance-visibility interlock remains a G3 concern unless direct ruleset verification or an exact repository-materialised DSAI attestation exists.
Transition debt is tracked; no zero claim and no DebtFloor exists at G2.5 gate preparation.
rollback: Before approval, close the unmerged gate PR. After a G2.5 PASS, disable LIMITED_NEW_ARTIFACT_ENFORCEMENT through an explicit operator-governed rollback/incident decision, preserve the pilot ledger and all failures, and return to enforcement NONE; do not rewrite history or create a DebtFloor.
exact_work_after_pass: Materialise the operator GRT2-G2.5 PASS decision and exact pilot baseline on the gate branch.
Activate LIMITED_NEW_ARTIFACT_ENFORCEMENT only; keep full Constitution/GRT-EXACT/DebtFloor G3 activation inactive.
Start the append-only G2.5 pilot ledger and full-G3 shadow comparison for every eligible integration candidate.
Accumulate at least 24 elapsed hours and at least 8 eligible candidate evaluations, preserving real ordinary and qualification-injection counts separately.
Run the required first-enforcement historical dry run and evaluate escapes, false positives, false negatives, scope leakage, performance, overrides and QA.
Prepare one consolidated GRT2-G3 operator packet only when all G3 readiness conditions are satisfied.
